subject.title: feat(linux): Quick Chat streamed replies and precise pairing states

question: Should Linux Quick Chat fully support BTW side-question replies in the new streamed-reply area, or should it reject/label that command until a distinct UX is approved?
rationale: The gateway deliberately separates BTW output from normal transcript events, and the PR introduces a new native reply surface whose intended semantics for that ephemeral result require maintainer direction.

options.title: Render BTW in Quick Chat
options.body: Handle `chat.side_result` as an explicitly ephemeral Quick Chat reply while retaining the normal `chat` stream path.

options.title: Reject BTW in this surface
options.body: Return a clear Quick Chat message for BTW rather than starting a normal streamed reply until a separate native UX is designed.

recommendation.title: Render BTW in Quick Chat
recommendation.body: Handle `chat.side_result` as an explicitly ephemeral Quick Chat reply while retaining the normal `chat` stream path.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history and assignment connect this contributor to the Linux Quick Chat implementation and its intended product scope.
